title: Before the Last Reading

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A thing left lying has two keepers: the hand that left it and the place that held it. The place keeps no account.
epigraph.attribution: A Low Kiln saying, told over a pot set down and forgotten

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and eighty-one to three hundred and eighty-three days, six months and two hundred and one to two hundred and three days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. As in chapters 25 through 109 the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break, no tagged memory, no departure from the boy's eyes. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool; the empty place beside it holding the fold of wool Sella put there on the fifteenth and found where put on six mornings and six goings of the light, with no second fold, third crust or name; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning. The chapter lives the last full working week before the year's last reading: the kiln banked behind its wall, the river under its winter skin, the yard going around its seven walked-around places with the returning-line place widest and once and not twice, the hearth grammar at both ends, the twice-mended pot kept apart from restoration, the dressed grain covered and unfigured. Eleven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure with the figure read still not the figure paid and no doctrine out of eleven; the keeping at the fold is found where put a seventh, eighth and ninth time and still adds no placing; and a fourth ownerless direction over the boards gathers about the shut room and the burned slate without becoming a sixth telling, a third shut-room telling, a witness or a payment. Stone 30, the year's last Account-day and the twelfth arithmetic, stands six mornings beyond the close and is not brought early.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Seventh Finding
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{381}{Stone 22, Secondday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof with the hand laid flat on answer 336 and the count exact at 380 carried out of Chapter 109, moving into the first morning of the last full working week. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects only (the salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease on the peg behind the door, the hollow wheel-seat, the clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey called the thaw left unswept, the twice-mended pot's hairline between old-brass staple and tighter wire, the unforged collector sentence at the kindling, the uncalled tile debt). No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, runner, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice — the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions stand where put and do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). No recap: nothing from Stone 19, 20 or 21 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the eleventh arithmetic behind one unsigned figure bought no teaching under this roof. Dramatic purpose: the seventh finding proves again that finding is not placing, and the nearness of the year's last reading buys no lesson. The surgeon takes the body in its old order — leathery brown-edged crust gone harder in the dry cold with its corner a hair off the wool; the wool folded once in the empty place exactly where put on the fifteenth; the thread frozen and unwiped; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; a face composed by cold is not composure and pink returning is surface still cold and not the core — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). **The keeping, seventh finding, advanced and NOT paid (T097/T060/T086):** the wool is found where put a seventh time, unchanged by the night; a seventh finding makes no seventh placing and no way, a habit would want a hand that placed twice and none stood, and a third placing would make a way wanting a payer where none stands. No second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer; it sits on a place of its own beside the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps in the room whose floor does not touch this one, the gone pan's round ring and the field's empty place, with a finger between it and every other kept thing, and is not laid across the eleven readings or the four rooms' gap. Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row and figures neither gap, glances once at the clay jar under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to the pot and the fire and never to a person, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark hangs untouched, for a morning and a hearth are not openings and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule with no eighth made due. Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed three hundred and eighty-one days (T088). In the small hours the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ends and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking: answer **337**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the eleven readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the keeping nor any other kept thing. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Well and the Wide Step
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 22 through the going of the light and the small hours at the close of the day with answer 338. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and damper, Ilva once at the yard well; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: a Cold Acre hare-carrier shifting a hare across his shoulders, a cracked-jar man in a rope sling, a woman with a basket of kindling, two fence-menders arguing the thaw. No Hessa, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice — the three Ash directions stand where put and do not repeat (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: the district's private count stays in wood and hands, and the keeping is not made a second time at the going of the light. Sella carries him down the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire she will bank against their coming back and never to the basket, level and out of the draught; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, by nothing measurable and once and not twice, because a second going-around would make a figure of once and a figure wants a payer standing under it (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). The clean dark line at the Vail corner keeps its finer grey called the thaw, unswept and thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash coming up off it; the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack are entered by nobody; the round ring where the shallow pan once stood keeps no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word. The gone white frost off the well's north lip, the skin drawn edge to edge across the trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair; the river's winter skin stays on its own place beside water over water, found where put and not spent on the going of the light or the week's work and not made to buy a lesson under any roof (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085). **Ilva, ninth record-first hand advanced and NOT paid (T080):** at the yard well she draws with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the Stone cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam she does not scrub out; her hand goes to the sleeve before her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both, with the half-beat in the gap, the short strip of notched birch unread in its fold and no figure coming off the wood; she answers the question put and not the one behind it, *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account*, puts the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve and goes back to the pail. She is expressly not the speaker of any voice; her ninth stays nine with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth and no tenth hand is filed. At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the knife at the very edge of its sill; he passes his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the coming away the whole of the checking, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count* and cuts nothing; the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting are found where put and not made again, not a sixth held object, not a seventh, not a tenth stopping (T036/T076/T006). His ear-sentence comes to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring at the left wrist, stroke over the shallow bright flagstone patch without the half-check, no look along the road, the fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his (T036/T076). At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip; three or more men unnamed have gone low into the back room before first grey and he gives no name for them and no word that the room is cold; dusty and clean forearms are parted as clot from vessel while the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack are entered by nobody; he speaks to the wheel before any person (*It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady*) and to a pot (*You'll do*) with no welcome and no unkindness, knowing the full note three turns ahead and withholding it from any master come up from High Kiln; his bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, takes the cold out of the fingertip, moves the tongue a hair's breadth and comes out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word covering both mercies (T062/T035/T031). *He's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn. At the going of the light Sella carries him up under the roof and never into the Debt Loft, sets him on the bed at the low angle of the loaf shelf, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and adds no second fold; the wool is found where put again at the going of the light and not made again; the thread is left frozen and unwiped; the hearth grammar is renewed with the charcoal unread, the grain unfigured, the widow's mark untouched and the fire's fifth unpaid. In the small hours the file comes out on the towel as instruments come out when a case is done, every gap left gap; the hand takes its small intake on the river's note and lays itself down on answer **338**, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air. The count stands at 381 exact, six months and two hundred and one days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number; Stone keeps its twenty-second day without a boundary drawn.

scenes.title: The Eighth Finding
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{382}{Stone 23, Thirdday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours with the hand laid flat on answer 338 and the count exact at 381, moving into the morning of the middle day of the last full working week. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Hessa Rale going up the clay road before noon; Garl Vail in objects. No Ilva, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice on this morning — the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions stand where put and do not repeat (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). New day, new date and no recap: the eleventh arithmetic behind one unsigned figure stands behind the household and bought no teaching here. Dramatic purpose: the eighth finding and the runner's unread carrying both advance and both refuse to stand up as a rule. The surgeon takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool and gone harder and browner in the dry cold; the wool folded once in the empty place; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and knows a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the careful rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; that a cold patient cannot clot, will seem better before he is worse, and warms extremity before core; while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). **The keeping, eighth finding, advanced and NOT paid (T097/T060/T086):** the wool is found where put an eighth time, unchanged by the night; eight findings from a hand that only read add no eighth placing, a habit would want a hand that placed twice and none stood, a way would want a third and both want a payer where none stands. No second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer, not a joining of rooms, not a tenth texture, not a sign, hearing, mending, cause or rule, and not laid across the eleven readings or the four rooms with the same gap. Sella's grammar holds at the hearth and the pot with the hairline showing, the dressed grain turned under wool without a figure or a handful, the charcoal unread beneath her finger, the widow's mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings (T058/T079/T100, T077). **Hessa Rale, eighth record-first hand advanced and NOT paid (T080):** going up the clay road toward Greybank before noon with Berr Clay's narrow slate held edge-on to her forearm and the writing turned toward her sleeve, the thumb along the grain of the frame and nothing pressing where the writing is, the second strap let out and dried pale scurf of road-mud unbrushed on the shortened skirt; the small flat correction of the strap and the turn of the wrist come first, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the yard, and no figure comes off the face of it; she answers the question put and not the one behind it, *I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which* and *Ask the road. It knows the way and I know the weight. That's the whole of what either of us knows*, settles the second strap again, gives no figure, reads nothing aloud and does not look into the basket, and goes on at the pace of a person who has made a bargain with distance. The boy files the turning of the writing toward herself on a place of its own beside the Ash 6 sighting with a finger between; no fifth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying, no reader, no witness, no payment, no joining to Ilva's strip, Berr's thumb, the charcoal, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate or any other private keeping; her eighth stays eight, no tenth hand is filed and eleven arithmetics going up the road behind her do not make her a reader. Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and its missing fifth, its payer unnamed three hundred and eighty-two days (T088). In the small hours the hand comes up an inch, takes its small intake on the river's note under the winter skin, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go as the note ends and lays itself flat on the fold on answer **339**, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; six hearings keep the seventh place empty, the Drawing's flat knock stays outside them on its own place, and the heard bell stays in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap (T061/T082).

scenes.title: A Fourth Direction
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 23, the going of the light and the small hours at the close of the day with answer 340. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and damper; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: a Cold Acre hare-carrier, a cracked-jar man in a rope sling, two fence-menders, a woman with kindling. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no market, Cross or bell. **The chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101):** an ownerless voice comes over the boards in the yard with no owner standing anywhere to be asked, going on with the day the way the yard says the weather, and gives the shut room and the burned slate a **fourth direction** — a room shut against the cold and a slate burned so a count would not go up, and the cold and the count going out through the same gap; no room named, no hand at any flame, no figure, no date, no person named and nobody standing to answer for the saying. The boy takes it apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart and files it on a place of its own beside the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions, with a finger between every pair; it is a fourth direction and expressly not a sixth telling of the burned slate (which stands at five), not a third shut-room telling (which stands at two), not a fifth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying (which stands at four), not a sixth asking of the row, not a witness, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a joining to Jorra's ungiven promise or to the keeping at the fold, not a payment and not a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood. It gathers interest toward the far-off hand that will one day lay the private keepings together and is not his and has not come. Nothing from the eleventh arithmetic or the keeping crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place, once and not twice; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere and the river's skin stays found where put and unspent (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085). At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip, passes his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, finds the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting where put and makes neither again, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, his stroke over the bright flagstones without the half-check and no look along the road (T036/T076/T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra keeps dusty and clean forearms on one tray, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note known three turns ahead from any High Kiln master, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and out again without a second holding of Ash 26; *he's not Vail* stays sealed, the promise is neither given nor withdrawn, and the burned slate's five tellings are not made six by the voice over the boards (T062/T035/T031). Sella's hearth grammar holds at both ends with the charcoal unread, the grain covered and unfigured, the widow's mark untouched and the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire; at the going of the light she sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, adds no second fold and leaves the thread frozen and unwiped; the wool is found where put again and not made again (T097/T060/T086, T058/T079). In the small hours the file comes out on the towel with every gap left gap — five held objects with the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and the holding in the damper beside them, the keeping at the fold beside all of them and expressly not a ninth held object, four rooms with the same gap held apart with a finger between every pair, nine record-first hands with no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth, eleven arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with no doctrine out of eleven, six hearings with the seventh place empty. The hand takes its small intake on the river's note and lays itself down on answer **340**, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the count stands at 382 exact, six months and two hundred and two days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number.

scenes.title: The Ninth Finding
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{383}{Stone 24, Fourthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours with the hand laid flat on answer 340 and the count exact at 382, moving into the morning of the last day of the last full working week before the year's last reading. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, runner, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice — the fourth direction of Stone 23 stands where put on a place of its own and does not repeat and buys no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). New day, new date and no recap: the fourth direction bought no teaching under this roof and the eleventh arithmetic stands behind the household without a doctrine. Dramatic purpose: the ninth finding is still a finding, and the week runs out without anything standing up and calling itself an account. The surgeon takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool and gone darker in the dry cold; the wool folded once in the empty place; the thread frozen and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and knows that pink returning is surface still cold and not the core, that a basket set level out of the draught is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for, while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). **The keeping, ninth finding, advanced and NOT paid (T097/T060/T086):** the wool is found where put a ninth time, unchanged by the night; nine findings from a hand that only read add no ninth placing, a second placing would make a habit and a third a way and both want a payer where none stands. No second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer, not a joining of rooms, not a tenth held object, not a sign, hearing, mending, cause or rule, and not laid across the eleven readings, the four rooms with the same gap or the fourth direction. Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row and figures neither gap, glances once at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire never to a person, turns the dressed grain under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and with no figure and no handful, and sets the rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). Repair stays apart from restoration: a restored thing hides the hand that handled it and a mended thing leaves that hand showing. The widow's mark hangs untouched — a morning, a hearth, a pot board and a bed are not openings, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule and no eighth is made due; the last firing behind the kiln wall bought no lesson and its fire keeps four low pulls with the fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed three hundred and eighty-three days (T058/T079, T088). Eleven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure with the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of eleven; the twelfth stands six mornings ahead on Stone 30 and is not brought into a day that has not earned it (T015/T041/T047 held). In the small hours the hand comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ends and lays itself flat on the fold on answer **341**, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, laid across neither the eleven readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the child's grey fingertips, the mother's cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction nor the keeping at the fold. Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the Drawing's flat knock stays outside them; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Count Goes On
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 24, the yard going around its places, the kindling and the damper checked, the carry home at the going of the light, the hearth grammar renewed, and the small hours at the very end of the day with the file out on the towel and answer 342. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail in the afternoon; Garl Vail in objects. No Ilva, Hessa, Berr, collector, green-mouthed woman or foundling; no market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice — the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions and Stone 23's fourth direction stand where put, do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). Dramatic purpose: check every object and leave every gap a gap, let the eleven readings, the keeping and the fourth direction gather interest without being paid, and close on forward motion toward the year's last reading. The clean dark line at the Vail corner and its finer grey called the thaw stay unswept with the faint sour tang of Ash; the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack are entered by nobody; the round ring where the shallow pan stood keeps no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the gone white frost, the skin on the trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone stay three coverings weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, and the river's winter skin stays on its own place beside water over water, found where put and not spent on the going of the light or the week's work (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085). Through the finger's-width door the river keeps its low note over a lower note, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, muffled under the winter skin as a voice is muffled by a shut door, with no hand that laid the skin, no payer under it and no source standing to be asked. At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, passes his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, finds the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting where put and makes neither again, and brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year now at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; a term ending is not a payment, a forgiveness or a freedom, and the fear of being entered again for vagrancy stays his; chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring at the left wrist catching and giving back what little light there is, stroke over the shallow bright flagstone patch without the half-check, no look along the road (T036/T076/T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip; unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name from him and no word that the room was cold; dusty and clean forearms are parted as clot from vessel while the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack stay entered by nobody; he speaks to the wheel before any person and tells a pot *You'll do* in a voice with no welcome and no unkindness, knowing the full note three turns ahead and withholding it from any master come up from High Kiln; his bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, takes the cold out of the fingertip, moves the tongue a hair's breadth and is left standing so that the end of the instruction arrives at the pot and the household straightens around the waiting, then comes out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time (T062/T035/T031). *He's not Vail* stays sealed as a lid nobody has tried to lift in three years, and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn, gathering interest against the burned slate at five and the three Ash directions and the fourth direction of Stone 23, none of which repeat or buy a lesson. At the going of the light Sella carries him up under the roof and never into the Debt Loft, sets him on the bed at the low angle of the loaf shelf, says nothing of where they have been, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and adds no second fold; the thread is left frozen and unwiped; the wool is found where put again and not made again. Under the roof she goes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, says *The house will keep it*, counts small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row and figures neither gap, glances once at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the crack showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, sets the rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and leaves the widow's mark untouched; under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed three hundred and eighty-three days (T058/T079/T100, T077, T088). In the small hours the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done and before the next is called, with every gap left gap: 341 honest answers stand on the sixth place and the 342nd is to come; five held objects stand with the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and the holding in the damper beside them, each on a place of its own with a finger between every pair, and the keeping at the fold stands beside all of them and is expressly not a ninth held object; the keeping was found where put on the mornings and at the goings of the light of Stone 22, 23 and 24 — a seventh, eighth and ninth finding — and nine findings from a hand that only read have added no ninth placing, a habit wanting a hand that placed twice and a way a third with no payer standing; nine record-first hands keep no tenth, nine stoppings keep no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, four rooms keep the same gap held apart with a finger between every pair, and the fourth direction of Stone 23 stands on a place of its own beside the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions with a finger between every pair; eleven arithmetics — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, the first, second and third of Ash, Stone's first and Stone's second — stand behind one unsigned figure, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of eleven, their eleven true subtractions riding locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road toward High Kiln with the key gone up in a coat pocket that does not come back down and the boy having no key; six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among, the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never among the sources, the seventh place empty and not dug for, and the flat knock of the Drawing on its own place outside them; the heard bell of the Long Night stays in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, not folded into any of them. No sixth hearing, seventh opening, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand, tenth stopping or twelfth arithmetic is supplied to make a row come out even, for a finding filled to make a row come out even is a finding forged. The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found, and it costs him nothing, which is how he knows it is not peace; the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle. Both are true. The second is louder. Neither wins, and the quarrel is the work, and he has stopped looking for a verdict in it, which is not the same as having found one. The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the low note under the finger's-width door, does not reach, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ends and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. He files it as answer **342**: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer. Stone keeps its twenty-second, twenty-third and twenty-fourth days without a boundary drawn, the deep-winter month holding both its names — older women by weather, slatemen by Account-days — neither set right nor left in so many words. The count stands at **383 exact**, six months and two hundred and three days told by nobody who would have known what a number counted, the carried fire's fifth unpaid the same number and Garl's name unspoken the same number. The wool lies folded once in the crust's empty place with its corner a hair off the wool, no second fold, no third crust and no name spoken over the place, and the thread is frozen and unwiped. Stone 25 and the year's last working week stand one morning away; Stone 30, the twelfth arithmetic, stands six mornings away and unbrought. The hand lies flat on the fold. The count goes on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath. Forward, not closed.
